name: Spaghetti Squash
siboNotes: Excellent choice for SIBO patients as it's naturally FODMAP-free and provides fiber without triggering symptoms.
preparationTips: Cut in half lengthwise and roast cut-side down at 400°F for 35-45 minutes
Scrape flesh with fork to create spaghetti-like strands
Can be steamed, microwaved, or slow-cooked as alternatives to roasting
Season after cooking to avoid burning spices during roasting
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and beta-carotene
